Qəbələ İdman Klubu, is an Azerbaijani professional football club based in Qabala, which has competed in the Azerbaijan Premier League since 2006. They will be set to play in the Azerbaijan Premier League from the 2025–26 season following their promotion from the Azerbaijan First Division in 2024–25. Gabala has been the runner up in the Premier League three times and has won the national cup twice, in 2019 and 2023.\nGabala is one of the 2 teams that started the first qualifying round of the UEFA Europa League for 2 seasons and managed to move on to the group stage.
